days.D1: unchanged overlap; executor expiry after page one; full retry from page one
days.D2: new job; executor expiry after page one; business-key dedup on retry
days.D3: historical update re-top; executor expiry after page one; detail refresh failure preserves prior detail
days.D4: same-time group split across pages; executor expiry after page one; complete group before checkpoint
days.D5: executor expiry before result; retry then missing-boundary quality rejection; failure receipt replay
days.D6: human termination and causal retry; second executor expiry; recovery from page one

scope_limit: This is a real non-root MySQL state/transaction contract. D0 process exit is covered by the separate live baseline recovery E2E; an OS-process Cartesian matrix for every D1-D6 cut remains a production gate.
